title: coax runs a real agent through Claude Code's ACP adapter
body:
Every session so far ran against `coax-fake-agent`. No real agent has been
behind coax, because no ACP agent is installed on this machine: there is no
node, and the Claude Code ACP adapter is an npm package.

## Proposal

Install nodejs and the adapter, with Jack's say-so on the installs, then run
`coax <adapter command>` inside decade with `--code` set, so the agent sees
decade's MCP tools. Expect protocol surprises on first contact and file each
one. Jack asked to hold this until the work that needs no tokens was done;
on 2026-11-06 that point is close.
close_reason: coax runs the Claude adapter's standalone release build with no node (memory claude-adapter-install). Jack uses it day to day through the picker; problems found in use get their own issues.

notes.author: Jack Roddy/4d38e22a
notes.text:
The first run against the real adapter worked with no change to coax.

The package moved from `zed-industries/claude-code-acp` to `agentclientprotocol/claude-agent-acp`. Node 22.23.4 is installed through mise with no version selected, so each command runs under `mise exec`. Setup and run:

```console
$ mise exec node@22.23.4 -- npm install --prefix tmp-claude/2026-11-08-zed-adapter/npm @agentclientprotocol/claude-agent-acp@0.101.0
$ CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_PROMPT_SUGGESTION=false mise exec node@22.23.4 -- target/debug/coax tmp-claude/2026-11-08-zed-adapter/npm/node_modules/.bin/claude-agent-acp
```

Auth came from the existing claude.ai login. Two turns ran: a Read and an `ls`, then a `touch`. coax showed each prompt, the tool calls with status and location, the reply, and `EndTurn` in the status line. The adapter wrote nothing to stderr. The replies followed the Dense output style from `~/.claude/settings.json`, so the adapter loaded the user settings.

Findings: coax-efe3a6 (long tool titles cut off) and coax-419109 (no permission request arrived). The agent's markdown shows as raw text, which is display work for coax-f16469.

notes.author: Jack Roddy/4d38e22a
notes.text: The adapter now runs from the standalone release build in `~/.local/share/claude-agent-acp/`, with no node; see the memory `claude-adapter-install`. `coax` picked the `claude` entry from `~/.config/coax/config.toml` and finished a turn with `PATH=/usr/bin:/bin`.
